description: We need to make the names between spring-cassandra & spring-data-cassandra consistent, so that spring-data-cassandra users have the same experience as other spring-data-* users.  Currently, there are some classes in spring-cassandra that are appropriately prefixed with Cassandra & Cql, and some that are not.  Similiarly in spring-data-cassandra, some classes have prefixes SpringData, Data, or other inconsistent prefixes.  All classes in both modules need review for consistent & appropriate prefixes.
